page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, consisting of a 3839 GB SSD. This high-capacity local storage is bundled directly with the instance, making it suitable for applications requiring rapid local data access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i4.4xlarge offers a high density of both memory and local SSD storage relative to its compute core count. This resource profile is optimized for workloads that demand significant local storage capacity and memory footprint without requiring dedicated GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include relational and non-relational databases, distributed file systems, caching layers, and data-intensive enterprise applications.
